records.title: GPON PCB Design: Can Your Board Actually Hold a Stable Burst-Mode Optical Signal?
records.snippet: The difficulty in GPON is not in the digital section — it is at that physical boundary layer. On the OLT side, you receive a faint optical signal that has traveled dozens of kilometers of fiber, and once it reaches the ONU, your circuit board has to recover the burst signal within nanoseconds while holding the laser driver current under absolutely tight control — the slightest overshoot and the eye diagram closes. An ordinary FR4 board simply cannot handle this. I eventually bit the bullet and went directly to a board shop that could provide a Rogers 4350B mixed-lamination solution, and insisted on impedance coupon testing. The extra cost was nothing compared to the sleepless nights spent debugging otherwise. ... So now, when I evaluate a PCB supplier, I completely ignore how many layers they claim to handle or how fine their trace width and spacing can go. I ask one question: how many boards have you built with burst-mode optical receivers, and do you have real eye-diagram template test data? If they cannot answer, I walk away. Building a GPON OLT or ONU is essentially a fight against picosecond-level jitter, and your circuit board is the battlefield. Do not expect to get away with a consumer-grade approach to a carrier-grade requirement — every differential pair, every impedance discontinuity on that board gets amplified by the fiber into packet loss.

records.snippet: ## 台積電、矽品及鴻海進入量產供應鏈；法人點名，上詮、波若威等也將成市場焦點。 ... 輝達（NVIDIA）於Hot chips 2026擴大Spectrum-X矽光子交換器布局。其中，搭載CPO（共同封裝光學）的Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics已進入量產，並藉由Multiplane架構支援最高51.2萬顆GPU。台積電、日月光投控旗下矽品及鴻海率先進入量產供應鏈；法人點名，上詮、波若威、光聖、旺矽等布局光纖陣列、FAU、高速連接及測試設備業者，也將成市場關注焦點。 ... 台廠分工方面，台積電負責矽光子元件製造，將PIC、EIC及先進封裝平台整合；矽品承擔晶片級封裝、組裝與測試，鴻海則負責將交換器整合為可裝入機架的完整網路系統。隨Vera Rubin放量，廣達旗下雲達、緯創、緯穎及英業達等AI伺服器廠，也將承接矽光子交換器、SuperNIC與機架系統整合需求。 ... 光學端的關鍵則轉向FAU、外部雷射、微透鏡、光纖耦合及主動對準。上詮、波若威、光聖及大立光等業者具備相關技術。 ... 法人分析，Spectrum-X矽光子交換器全面量產，代表CPO已由技術展示跨入商業化階段。台灣供應鏈的價值也將由零組件製造，進一步延伸至矽光子製程、精密光學組裝、封裝測試與機架系統整合。

records.snippet: What’s behind the Open Silicon Photonics for AI Systems initiative inside OCP? Nick Harris, Co-Founder and CEO of Lightmatter, provides an introduction. Lightmatter and coalition partners have published a whitepaper addressing critical infrastructure challenges facing AI data centers as computational demands scale exponentially. Harris explains how physical limitations in copper connectivity are creating a bottleneck for next-generation AI clusters, and discusses the emerging photonics technologies positioned to solve this problem. The initiative aims to establish standardized rack architectures that will enable the deployment of co-packaged optics and silicon photonics across AI data center infrastructure. ... – Copper reach limitations are constraining high-speed data transfer in AI clusters – Computational domain requirements are expanding from 72 GPUs to thousands of XPUs – Silicon photonics technologies are emerging as solutions for GPU scale-up networks – The role of industry standardization in enabling next-generation AI data center infrastructure – How co-packaged optics and silicon photonics will transform rack-scale architecture ...
